name: daas-take-home
description: DaaS Sprint 2 slice - purchase order receiving

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta -k --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.setup: npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix api run prisma:generate && npm run db:up && npm --prefix api run migrate && npm --prefix api run seed
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
